headline: State Minister's car crashes into paddy field while saving woman
summary: Public Administration and Food State Minister Abdul Bari was injured in a road accident in Bogra's Shibganj while attempting to avoid hitting a pedestrian.
details: State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari, was involved in a road accident in Shibganj, Bogra, on Friday morning around 9:00 AM.

While traveling to Kalai, Joypurhat, the State Minister's vehicle lost control and plunged into a roadside paddy field near the Kichak Bridge to avoid hitting a woman who suddenly appeared on the road.
The woman, identified as 55-year-old Firoza Begum from Gadgari village, was injured in the incident and was rushed to Zia Medical College Hospital for treatment.
State Minister Abdul Bari and his gunman, Muktarul, were also injured in the crash. The State Minister was taken to Kalai Hospital for medical attention.
According to Kalai Police Station OC Saidul Alam, the State Minister did not suffer any serious injuries and only had minor marks on his leg.
caption:
A State Minister's car plunged into a paddy field after the driver swerved to save a pedestrian. Three people were injured.

State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari, was involved in a road accident in Shibganj, Bogra, on Friday morning around 9:00 AM.

While traveling to Kalai, Joypurhat, the State Minister's vehicle lost control and plunged into a roadside paddy field near the Kichak Bridge to avoid hitting a woman who suddenly appeared on the road.

The woman, identified as 55-year-old Firoza Begum from Gadgari village, was injured in the incident and was rushed to Zia Medical College Hospital for treatment.

State Minister Abdul Bari and his gunman, Muktarul, were also injured in the crash. The State Minister was taken to Kalai Hospital for medical attention.

According to Kalai Police Station OC Saidul Alam, the State Minister did not suffer any serious injuries and only had minor marks on his leg.

headline_marked: 3 killed as [[bus rear-ends parked covered van]] in Feni
headline: 3 killed as bus rear-ends parked covered van in Feni
summary: The accident occurred on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway in Chhagalnaiya upazila, leaving one person injured.
details: Three people were killed and another injured when a Dhaka-bound Unique Paribahan bus, travelling at high speed, hit a parked covered van from behind on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway.
The crash occurred around 7:30 am in front of the Daulatpur Government Primary School in Muriganj, Feni Sadar upazila.
The collision left the covered van driver, his helper, the bus driver, and another person critically injured.
Local residents and highway police rescued the victims and rushed them to Feni General Hospital, where doctors declared three of them dead.
Police have kept the bodies at the morgue for autopsy and are working to confirm the identities of the deceased.
Both vehicles involved in the accident have been seized by the police as legal procedures are underway.
caption:
A high-speed bus crash in Feni has left 3 people dead and one injured.

Three people were killed and another injured when a Dhaka-bound Unique Paribahan bus, travelling at high speed, hit a parked covered van from behind on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway.

The crash occurred around 7:30 am in front of the Daulatpur Government Primary School in Muriganj, Feni Sadar upazila.

The collision left the covered van driver, his helper, the bus driver, and another person critically injured.

Local residents and highway police rescued the victims and rushed them to Feni General Hospital, where doctors declared three of them dead.

Police have kept the bodies at the morgue for autopsy and are working to confirm the identities of the deceased.

Both vehicles involved in the accident have been seized by the police as legal procedures are underway.
